intro: Add comfort and style to every meal with Diner chairs. A cushioned beige fabric seat, broad angular backrest, and espresso wood frame give you lasting support while enhancing your dining space with elegance.

features.title: Stay comfortable from meal to meal
features.text: Soft foam cushioning with 28 kg/m³ density keeps you cozy through everyday dinners, festive family gatherings, or late-night chats.

features.title: Broad backrest for lasting support
features.text: The angular high backrest offers ergonomic support, so your posture stays comfortable even during long conversations at the table.

features.title: Strong solid rubberwood frame
features.text: Crafted from sturdy rubberwood with an espresso finish, the frame gives you durability and warmth for everyday dining use.

features.title: Minimal design with modern appeal
features.text: Clean lines and espresso shade create a timeless design that complements both traditional and contemporary dining setups.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
